cohort: This study included 145 preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks gestational age or with a birth weight less than 1500 g who were admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit between September 2015 and December 2020.
finding: Prolonged prenatal antibiotic exposure was associated with a higher BW/GA Z-score but also increased the risk of death, NEC, and LOS in very preterm or very low birth weight infants.
